entries.note: Neither winning AI supremacy nor the race being temporarily over has a shared evidentiary threshold.

entries.test: DeepSeek's December release, benchmark results, and comparable training-cost disclosures would establish whether it approached leading models at roughly one-fiftieth their training cost.
entries.note: The tentative company-origin aside does not hedge the principal performance and cost assertion.

entries.test: Subsequent American AI releases and technical reports would show whether companies incorporated the Chinese techniques and produced further advances of their own.
entries.note: The forecast has no deadline; the opening sentence rejects an inference of Chinese victory.

entries.test: Contemporaneous OpenAI revenue, spending, and application-level commercial results would show whether revenue was around $5 billion, substantially below outlays, with no application commercially justifying those costs.
entries.note: The explicit comparison with costs gives 'killer app' a usable commercial reading.
Economic sensibility and the combined judgment of openness and innovation lack a specified evaluative standard.
'May well' asserts a possibility, not a firm prediction.
The dollar amount does not make the judgment of sensibility objectively decidable.
The predicted backfire is explicitly conditional and qualified by 'may'.
The central assertion concerns GPT-5's future strategic significance, despite its retrospective wording. 'Matter in the long run' supplies no shared outcome measure.
'Magical thinking' expresses his critical assessment of the policy.
This evaluates Brundage's relative emphasis; framing it as 'Marcus thinks' does not turn that evaluation into an empirical observation.

entries.test: Public scaling experiments and deployment results would show whether access to additional chips continues to materially affect achievable model capabilities or capacity despite efficiency advances.
entries.note: Marcus explicitly adopts the chip-supply prediction in his own voice. The accompanying 'game has changed' language is less precise.
'Might well' leaves the predicted increase in risks probabilistic.
Marcus expressly endorses the recommendation he attributes to Musk.
'Unless something changes' supplies an antecedent, and 'may' makes the outcome a possibility.

entries.test: Model capability improvements and the time competitors take to match them through January 26, 2028, compared with the preceding period, would test the predicted smaller advances and faster matching under otherwise comparable conditions.
entries.note: The introductory 'other things being equal' qualifies the prediction. 'My bet' followed by 'will' expresses a firm expectation, despite the drafter's 'likely' label.

entries.test: Public releases and capability comparisons would establish whether GPT-5 or a comparable advance arrived and whether competitors matched its advantage within months rather than years, other things being equal.
entries.note: 'Eventually' supplies no firm release deadline despite the surrounding three-year framing. The uncertain identity of the first producer does not hedge the predicted arrival or short-lived advantage.

entries.test: Comparable model efficiency, pricing, hallucination, and reliability measurements through January 26, 2028, would show whether costs and resource requirements fell while reliability failures persisted, other things being equal.
entries.note: The introductory condition applies, but the outcome is firmly predicted.

entries.test: Public demonstrations and independent evaluations available by December 31, 2027, would show whether either country produced AI with broadly human-level general capabilities under otherwise comparable conditions.
entries.note: The explicit 2027 deadline controls. The text says 'neither country will,' not merely that AGI is unlikely.

entries.test: Public research budgets, staffing allocations, and documented funding decisions through January 26, 2028, would show whether continued LLM competition diverted resources from alternative AI approaches.
entries.note: The proposition omits the surrounding three-year horizon. The central assertion is actual resource diversion; 'might' qualifies alternative uses.

entries.test: Public model evaluations and technical disclosures could show whether an LLM-based approach establishes a decisive, sustained US lead, contradicting the asserted necessity of moving beyond LLMs.
entries.note: The passage asserts a necessary condition and explains it through widely understood techniques. A sustained LLM-based lead would provide a decisive counterexample.
